claim: Channels are 10-bit (to 1,023) and below 100 are the engine's, so a level has 924 of its own; the campaign's busiest map uses 145. What runs out first is XSECTORs (4,096 in NBlood) and receivers: an object has one rx, so a piece of floor lit by two shootable lamps can go dark with only one of them.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/db.h:27 kMaxXSectors 4096; db.h:60-61 txID and rxID : 10 bits
campaign's most is 145 channels, Gravesend used 95 of 924 with 654 XSECTORs (projects/blood-city/level/shot_lamps.py docstring)
use: Count XSECTORs, not channels, when wiring light; put switchable lamps where each lights its own pool.
